subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and which existing substrate should own the durable final-delivery obligation?
rationale: Current main has partial owner-key and delivery-state mechanisms, but the requested public owner-mode/final-obligation contract would change model-facing tools, plugin hooks, persisted state, and visible message delivery.

options.title: Keep and narrow here
options.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode/substrate contract, then recut a smaller implementation with docs and live proof.

options.title: Declare current substrates sufficient
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only if maintainers decide completionOwnerKey plus task/subagent delivery state already covers the intended invariant.

options.title: Move to a narrower delivery issue
options.body: Redirect the invariant to a more specific delivery ledger/origin tuple issue if maintainers want this thread to stop being canonical.

recommendation.title: Keep and narrow here
recommendation.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode/substrate contract, then recut a smaller implementation with docs and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the strongest recent current-main history on the completionOwnerKey substrate and is the best available routing candidate for the product/API decision.
